records.title: Air 12V Auxiliary Battery Drain (Sentry-Like Modes Enabled)
records.description: Lucid Air drains the 12V auxiliary battery during long parking, especially when Surveillance Mode or remote-access features are active. Pattern consistent with other premium EVs. Software updates have reduced parasitic draw but the issue persists for some owners.
records.solution: Disable Surveillance Mode for parking stretches over 1 week. Update to latest software. Use a 12V battery maintainer if storing more than 2 weeks. AGM 12V replacement under warranty for documented failures; out-of-warranty ~$300-$500 at Lucid service center.

records.title: Air Charge Port LED Indicator Faults
records.description: Lucid Air charge-port LED ring (which displays charging state via color) can fail to display correctly — sometimes showing wrong color, flickering, or going dark while still actively charging. Cosmetic-only in most cases (charging still works), but confusing for owners trying to verify session state.
records.solution: Soft fix: power-cycle the charging session (unplug + replug). Hardware fix: charge port assembly module replacement under warranty. Out-of-warranty estimate $250-$500.

records.title: Air Heat Pump Fault Codes (Cold Weather)
records.description: Lucid Air heat pump-based HVAC system reports cold-weather faults in some 2022-2024 vehicles — symptoms include reduced or no cabin heat in temperatures below freezing, longer charge-port preconditioning, and reduced overall range in cold. Software updates have improved cold-weather behavior but hardware-level faults occur in some units.
records.solution: Update to latest software. Pre-condition cabin and battery via app before driving in cold. Hardware faults (refrigerant leak, compressor failure) covered under bumper-to-bumper warranty — schedule Lucid service inspection.

records.title: Lucid Air Webasto HVCH Recall (SR-24-04-0, Failure to Defrost)
records.description: Lucid issued recall SR-24-04-0 in mid-2024 covering 2022-2024 Lucid Air vehicles for high voltage coolant heater (HVCH) failure — the Webasto AG-supplied HVCH could suffer internal delamination, causing failure to defrost the windshield in cold weather (an FMVSS 103 violation). Owner notification letters mailed August 5, 2024. Some users also reported sudden loss of drive symptoms linked to the same component.
records.solution: Free recall remedy at Lucid Studio: software update to identify HVCH failure + warning, and Webasto HVCH replacement when failure is detected. Confirm VIN status via Lucid customer service or NHTSA recall lookup.

records.title: Air Infotainment / Center Display Freezes (Early Production)
records.description: Early-production (2021-2023) Lucid Air infotainment system reports frequent freezing, slow boot times, glitches with CarPlay (since added via update), and unresponsive Pilot Panel (smaller lower screen used as touch HVAC + camera control). Multiple OTA updates have improved but pattern persists in some VINs.
records.solution: Hard reset: hold both scroll wheels on steering wheel until reboot. Stay current on OTA updates. Severe cases require service center compute-stack replacement under warranty.

records.title: Air Paint Quality / Orange-Peel + Inclusions (Early Production)
records.description: Early Lucid Air (2021-2022, particularly Dream Edition cars built at the Casa Grande, AZ AMP-1 ramp) reports paint orange-peel, dust inclusions, and color match issues across panels. Manufacturing quality improved across 2023; severe cases were repainted under warranty.
records.solution: Document with photos at delivery and during the first 90 days of ownership. Lucid customer service has approved goodwill repaints for documented quality issues. PPF on at-risk areas can prevent further damage but won't fix existing flaws.

records.title: Air Panoramic Glass Roof Wind Noise / Seal Issues
records.description: Lucid Air owners report wind noise and occasional water ingress at the panoramic glass roof seal — pattern in early production but present across years. The single-piece glass roof creates a tight tolerance challenge that some VINs ship outside of spec.
records.solution: Schedule Lucid service to inspect/adjust seal — adjustment or seal replacement covered under warranty. Severe water ingress (interior wetness) is a higher priority and may need full re-seal ($300-$600 out-of-warranty).

records.title: Air Rear Drive Unit Mount / Bushing Wear (Early Production)
records.description: Some early Lucid Air owners report a clunk or thud from the rear of the vehicle during acceleration off-throttle and engagement of regen braking. Often traced to rear drive unit mount or subframe bushing tolerance issues. Lucid has issued service bulletins addressing several variants of the symptom.
records.solution: Document the clunk with phone audio and schedule a Lucid service appointment — repairs covered under powertrain warranty (8 yr / 100,000 mi). Out-of-warranty mount/bushing replacement likely $400-$900.

records.title: Electric door handles fail to retract, present, or latch properly
records.description: Gravity's electrically actuated door handles intermittently fail to present on approach, stick in the extended position, or fail to trigger the latch when the door is pushed closed. Owners report sluggish response and unintended repeat movements. Lucid issued software fixes and has publicly committed to abandoning electric handles entirely on upcoming midsize models, signaling the design's reliability problems.
records.solution: Install latest OTA (V3.5.0 or later) which specifically addresses unintended repeated handle movements and adds faster door-opening response. If failures persist, request actuator inspection/replacement under warranty (4-year/50,000-mile basic). Interior manual emergency releases work as a backup. Note: Lucid has announced upcoming midsize models (starting with Cosmos) will use mechanical handles, indirectly acknowledging the design's reliability issues.
symptoms: Handle won't pop out on approach
Handle stays extended and won't retract
Door won't latch when pushed closed

records.title: HVAC auto mode buggy: screeching passenger vent, fan blasts, settings don't persist
records.description: Gravity owners report multiple HVAC defects: a loud screeching noise from the passenger front vent on fan levels 1-5, auto mode running fan excessively loud, temperature feeling far cooler than the setpoint (72F feels chilly even in 40F weather), defrost requiring manual activation, and HVAC settings (auto, vent direction, rear zone) not persisting between drive cycles. Interim CEO Marc Winterhoff publicly acknowledged the climate issues in late 2025.
records.solution: Install latest available software update — Lucid has acknowledged Gravity climate control issues and is rolling out refined fan-speed logic in upcoming OTA updates (3.3.20 addressed key fob/infotainment; climate refinements expected in a subsequent release per Electrek 12/22/2025). For the screeching passenger vent on fan levels 1-5, request blower-motor / vent actuator inspection under warranty. Manually set fan speed, vent direction, and defrost each drive until firmware fully resolves persistence and auto-mode behavior.
symptoms: Cabin doesn't warm or cool to setpoint

records.title: Incorrect front seat backrest covers may block side airbag deployment (NHTSA 25V855)
records.description: Recall 25V855 (Dec 10, 2025) affects 66 model-year 2026 Gravity vehicles. Piston Interiors mislabeled driver- and passenger-side backrest covers (produced Sept 2025); Hyundai Transys installed some incorrectly. The wrong cover can prevent the side airbag from tearing the seam and deploying correctly in a side-impact crash, increasing injury risk.
records.solution: Dealer inspects and replaces the front seat backrest covers as necessary, free of charge per recall 25V855. Owner notifications mailed Feb 6, 2026. Call Lucid Customer Care 1-888-99-LUCID.
symptoms: Side airbag may fail to deploy in side-impact crash

records.title: Key fob not detected / 'key not detected' alerts since launch
records.description: Gravity owners report persistent key fob recognition failures since first deliveries in late 2024 (Dream Edition) and through the 2025 model year. Vehicle frequently displays 'key not detected,' locks owners out, or won't shift into drive. Lucid pushed multiple software updates touching key fob detection (3.3.1 on 9/16/2025, 3.3.5 on 10/16/2025, 3.3.20 on 12/12/2025, 3.4.0/3.4.1 on 1/28/2026) and added a wireless fob firmware update tool in the mobile app (October 2025), but complaints persisted through 2026. Mobile Key (BLE phone-as-key) confirmed by VP Nick Twork for Q3 2026.
records.solution: Update to the latest Gravity OTA (3.4.x or newer) and use the Lucid mobile app's wireless fob firmware update tool (each fob can be updated individually over Bluetooth without being near the vehicle). If failures persist, contact Lucid Customer Care to request a fob exchange. Mobile Key is expected Q3 2026 as a phone-based fallback.
symptoms: Doors opening during turns (related access-control issue)

records.title: Navigation routes wrong: false turns, missed addresses, GPS sends drivers off-route
records.description: Remove the unsupported claim about the 'New Bugs Since 3.5.1' thread exceeding 300 replies on navigation — that thread is about frozen screens, key fobs, and locks, not navigation. Either drop the reference or replace with the actual lucidowners.com 'Lucid Navigation Opinions' thread (which is primarily Air-focused but has Gravity GT owner reports). The Autoblog citation is weak for navigation specifically (it covers window/cruise/camera issues on the Gravity loaner) — consider replacing with a more nav-focused source.
records.solution: Keep software current (3.4+). As workaround, mirror Apple CarPlay/Android Auto (added in later OTAs) or run Google Maps on phone for routing. Report specific bad routes to Lucid Customer Care so they can be fed back to HERE.

Map drops pin at wrong location

records.title: Rearview camera blank screen in reverse (NHTSA 26V018)
records.description: Recall 26V018 affects ~3,900 Gravity SUVs on software earlier than 3.3.20. Intermittent power-state/view signal delivery and improper error handling in the camera pipeline cause the rearview image to fail to display when shifted to Reverse, violating FMVSS 111. Per NHTSA filings, 438 owners had not yet accepted the OTA at filing time.
records.solution: Accept the free over-the-air update to software version 3.3.20 or later. If OTA fails, schedule a service visit with Lucid — flashing can be done in-shop.
symptoms: Blank rearview camera screen when in Reverse
Camera feed intermittently fails to load

records.title: Second-row seat belt anchor bracket weld failure (NHTSA 26V192)
records.description: NHTSA recall 26V192 affects 4,476 Gravity SUVs built before Feb 14, 2026. The outboard lap belt anchor bracket on the second-row seat may have welds that are too short or in the wrong location, failing FMVSS 207/210. Seat supplier Camaco changed the weld design without Lucid's approval. Risk: belt anchor pulls free in a crash.
records.solution: Owner notification date in candidate says 'April 2026' but cars.com reports notification letters expected May 22, 2026. Consider updating to 'Owner notifications mailed May 2026' for accuracy.
symptoms: Possible second-row belt failure in collision
